questions.q: ___ I like him, I can't lend him any more money.
questions.why: *Much as* + підмет + дієслово = «хоч і»: *Much as I like him, …*
Прикметник + *as* + підмет + дієслово: *Tired as she was* (без інверсії).
*Here comes the bus!* — дієслово перед іменником-підметом.
З займенником інверсії немає: *Here it comes.*

questions.q: I find ___ difficult to concentrate in the morning.
questions.why: *find it* + прикметник + *to*: *I find it difficult to…* — формальне *it* обов'язкове.

questions.q: ___ he might, he couldn't open the door.
questions.why: *Try as he might* — як він не намагався.

questions.q: I'd appreciate ___ if you could reply soon.
On the hill ___ an old castle.
questions.why: Обставина місця на початку — дієслово перед підметом: *On the hill stood an old castle.*

questions.q: Strange ___ it may seem, it's true.
questions.why: Прикметник + *though* + підмет: *Strange though it may seem*.

options: the offer we made last week
the offer we made last week down
questions.why: Довгий додаток стоїть після частки: *turned down the offer we made last week*.
Формальне *It* замість довгого підрядного: *It surprised everyone that he resigned.*

questions.q: Much ___ I admire her, I don't agree with her.
The noise made ___ impossible to sleep.
___ goes my train! I've missed it.

answer: Much as I like her I can't agree
Much as I like her, I can't agree
I can't agree much as I like her
questions.hint: Хоч вона мені й подобається, я не можу погодитися.

answer: I find it hard to believe

questions.why: *Here comes the bus* — інверсія з іменником.

answer: Tired as he was he finished the job
